biography.value: Voice Aetherim are authority figures. Mass Healing sustains entire parties; Divine Authority suppresses aggression in a single target without charm immunity applying; Word of Light stuns enemies through spoken command. A summoner who calls one into a complex encounter involving both combat and potential negotiation will find it capable of contributing meaningfully in both registers. It will also express opinions about the encounter's participants based on what Detect Evil and Perfect sigh reveal — observations delivered matter-of-factly and without diplomatic softening, because Voice Aetherim have no particular investment in sparing feelings when the truth is relevant.

system.attacksNotes:
Radiant Strike [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 8 + Melee Combat 5), Reach: 5 ft.

  • Margin 1:: 11 damage (7 + 4 Str) + 3 Positive damage (Half DR).
  • Margin 2: 11 damage, DR halved (round up) + 3 Positive damage; undead Frightened for 1 minute; Will [Hard] save to resist.
  • Margin 3: 11 damage, DR halved (round up) + 3 Positive damage; Frightened; no save; undead at half HP or below destroyed outright.

Word of Light [Combat]: Ranged attack (Cha 6 + Religion 5), Range: 60 ft

  • Margin 1:: Target makes Will [Easy] save or Dazed until end of their next turn.
  • Margin 2: Target Stunned until end of their next turn; Will [Hard] save to resist.
  • Margin 3: Target Stunned for 1 minute; Will [Hard] save each round to end; undead also take 16 Positive damage (Half DR); no save on damage.
system.specialAbilitiesNotes: Mass Healing (1/short rest) [Combat]: As 2 [Combat] actions, releases a pulse of Positive energy in a 30-foot diameter. All living allies in range heal HP equal to the Voice Aetherim's Wisdom score (7). Cannot affect undead or constructs. Protective Aura: Allies within 30 feet of the Voice Aetherim gain +3 DR against all damage. This aura is always active. Turn Undead (1/encounter) [Combat]: As a [Combat] action, releases a pulse of Positive energy in a 30-foot diameter. All undead in range make a Will save (opposed by Wis 7 + Religion 5). On failure, undead are Frightened and must move away from the Voice Aetherim as fast as possible for 1 minute. They cannot willingly move closer for the duration. Divine Authority: When the Voice Aetherim addresses a creature directly and that creature fails a Will save (opposed by Cha 6 + Persuasion 5), the creature cannot take harmful actions for 1 round as divine authority momentarily overwhelms their aggression. This is not Charm. Detect Evil: Automatically senses creatures with actively malicious intent within 120 feet and communicates their general direction and distance to the summoner as a [Free] action each round. Continual Radiance: Sheds bright light in a 40-foot radius and dim light for an additional 40 feet. The Shield Aetherim cannot suppress this light voluntarily. Resilient Defense (1/day): When the Voice Aetherim fails a saving throw, it may choose to succeed instead. Action Points (3): Boss template. Spend at the end of any other creature's turn: Move (1, up to half speed), Attack (1, no Multiple Action Penalty), Detect (1), Special Ability (2). Regains all at the start of its own turn.
